question: Which technology-use interventions improve sleep, attention, relationships, or wellbeing without relying on simplistic screen-time claims?
evidence_target: Prefer systematic reviews and trials that distinguish type/context of use from total duration.
guardrail: Do not treat total screen time as a universal causal metric or prescribe a single safe threshold.
stage_summary: A reviewed Evidence Decision and trusted Topic protocol exist, but no explicit closure record exists yet.
